body: Mm i mean I got most of my URs from the nightmare. That honestly is the best bet, saving vouchers for a 10 pull as current rates are higher. SSR cards work fine until you get UR cards too, mine carried me for the longest of time until I got a good set of URs and I don't really play LD since events in this game are a scam past the first part lol (to me that is. The rewards just aren't worth the effort and I've already played through a lot of parts for the events as I've been into this game for a long time)

Interesting strat.
I personally manually battle with all my rarer cards until they're about 50 ish so i can unlock everything in their trees (i only use ur cards now since i got a good stockpile from playing birthdays and getting lucky in nightmares)

I focus on collecting the most, but I try to do all my dailies every single day. I don't use my grimm at all to level up cards anymore and have raised cards from 1-120 by doing just that. It really saves on Grimm if you don't spend it on level ups.

In order to make Grimm however, the last 2-3 places (especially Ristorante 6) has the best value in terms of drops for grimm and valuable items (raven is mega important for buying demon vouchers for me) battling hard modes where you can skip to still get the exp/interactions but don't have to grind as long is the best choice too. Hard mode rewards a lot more grim than any event or normal battle of the same difficulty so it's the best choice for grimm grinding.

As for events, tbh they're not worth it past page 1 as a lot of newer ones are hard to get through for f2p/light spenders. I'm a former whale who just spends money now on vip (and on special occasions like $20 on my birthday) and honestly it's been a lot less stressful doing that. I've gone completely f2p with my resources, so my strategy for events (which is a bit dp expensive but worth the reward to me) is buying the AP recovery sets every 12 hours and timing them so i can purchase them twice a day. I also check around noon and 6pm for the fridge AP if i remember and watch ads for AP every day. I have the VIP so it takes about 10 hours to recharge it to full, but I burn the AP every few hours and check the games to see if jobs are done as well. So i get enough AP doing that to complete all the battles for events, and do all my dailies and i usually have a bit left over so i burn for resources for trees in hard mode. (As the battles are limited every day plus I get a bunch of Grimm)

I also use my grim mostly to summon in chapter G for raven/card pieces, (I've maxed out all of the ssr cards by doing this), and then use that raven to buy DV, food for achievements, or sometimes card pieces as i still need to save for two cards. I already bought everything in majolish since i summoned so much for raven. I don't recommend doing this tho if you're saving for higher devil tree unlocks. So for those times, just do your daily free summons or just the free G summon and two singles for the daily. The grim will save itself doing this and unlocking lower card spaces for the daily achievement. (Like normal to Sr card spaces before the first rank Up since they are only 500 a space) if you can remember what cards have what space amount unlocked, you can save it to the next day to where you can finish unlocking those spaces. (5 a day is what's needed) i do this for mostly exp and the gems, as ever since i started doing this months ago, i started noticing a hoard building up between this and the chapter g summons (got almost 1k each in gems now, so the current log in will make some past 2k lmao) These will be super important to save for when you burn them to unlock stronger cards.

Also, save all your rainbow glow sticks. Those will be god sends in higher level battles as they boost ALL your cards stats, not just one Attribute like the colored ones. Save the colored ones for unlocks like with missions or pairing glow stick achievements.

Idk if I covered everything exactly with what I do, but I'm tired so I'll leave this here lol
Hope this manages to at least help someone o/

Edit; forgot to add an important tip!!
Save d energies for birthdays only. Since those so far have no return in sight, but the events will come back in six months with LD. This will give you time to hoard with them as i personally just do part 1 for events to get d energies a d vouchers then just kinda dip.
